messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we scheduled a CA rotation for the on-prem keystore cluster next Tue 02:00 UTC. This will touch mTLS between edge-proxy -> compute nodes and the KMS signing handshake. Need a short security checklist: RBAC review for keystore-controller, audit policy tweak to capture cert lifecycle events, and a rollback plan if nodes start failing TLS.

ton y: @maria do we expect any API downtime or only rolling restarts?

maria: rolling restarts only, should be zero downtime if probes pass. but risk: older tenants with pinned cert chains may fail mutual TLS until they fetch new CA bundle.

olivia: we need to ensure KMS client uses CA bundle from the keystore service, not host store. previous bug had client fallback to system store which caused silent verification. can we patch the client image to enforce PKCS#11 path?

maria: yes — patch proposed. will push a canary to 3 clusters first.

nina: FYI netpols currently have conntrack timeouts low for edge-proxy. during cert rotation we might see many TLS handshakes and hit conntrack limit -> packet drops. suggest bumping conntrack governor for the maintenance window.

ryan: can we get a short runbook section for incident response? If a node starts rejecting KMS sign requests we should: 1) detect via audit (error 403/504 patterns), 2) fail open to dedicated fallback KMS (only for <5m), 3) abort rotation and roll back CA on control plane.

sec-bot: Runbook template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-ca-rotation — includes detection rules and fallback policy.

maria: Olivia, can you own the audit policy delta? We need these events captured at INFO+: cert_issue, cert_rotate, cert_revoke, kms_sign_fail. Also include subject CN and thumbprint in logs (redact private key).

olivia: on it. Suggest adding structured fields to the audit logs so we can query quickly: {"event":"cert_rotate","subject":"CN=...","thumbprint":"sha256:...","actor":"svcacct/keystore-ctrl"}. Will redact via field-level policy.

ryan: Example detection query (for sig):
```
index=keystore_logs "kms_sign_fail" | stats count by thumbprint, actor | sort - count
```

maria: For RBAC: we need a temporary scoped role for the rotation agent, with expiration 4h and no write to tenant-keystores. Only allowed to update cluster-keystore CRs. Tony, please propose a minimal Role/RoleBinding.

tony: Draft Role:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: ca-rotation-agent
rules:
- apiGroups: ["infra.redwood.com"]
  resources: ["clusterkeystores"]
  verbs: ["get","update","patch"]
```
I'll attach a bounded RoleBinding to a short-lived serviceAccount and use OPA gate for approval.

nina: Also plan: open maintenance comms and whitelist healthcheck IPs on egress proxy so monitoring keeps flowing. add a temporary netpol that allows edge-proxy -> authn for cert exchange.

olivia: Question about KMS integration: during rotation we sign new intermediate with HSM-backed root. Do we need to rewrap any existing tenant keys in KMS? My concern: previous rewrap job caused a spike and partial failures.

maria: No automatic rewrap for tenant data keys. We only rotate the CA used for TLS. Tenant data encryption keys remain untouched. Rewrapping is a separate migration with its own plan.

ryan: Action items summary (short):
- olivia: audit policy change + structured fields (ETA 24h)
- tony: role + binding draft + OPA gate (ETA 12h)
- nina: conntrack bump plan + netpol whitelist (ETA 8h)
- maria: schedule canary, comms, rollback script (ETA 36h)
- ryan: detection query + fallback KMS config (ETA 12h)

maria: If anyone sees a compliance gap (esp around evidence of key custody), flag now. We need logs to satisfy SOC2-like evidence for the rotation.

olivia: Will add a short proof bundle generator to collect signed log excerpts and the CA thumbprint to S3 (read-only) for audit.

sec-bot: Note: emergency eviction procedure exists: https://redwood.internal/ops/evict-tenant — use only if compromise suspected. It steps through revoking tenant certs, rotating session tokens, and ingesting forensics.

maria: Last note — test plan for canary: 3 clusters, 1 tenant on each with pinned cert sim, then ramp to 30% of clusters. If 5xx > 0.5% abort.

tony: ack, I'll include a `kubectl rollout restart` snippet and readiness probe checks.

maria: thanks all. I'll open a PR with the schedule and attach the runbook. Please comment early if you have concerns. :thumbsup:)
